'''Barancar''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]]. It was a part of the [[Kingdom of Cron]], and was eventually conquered by [[Xer VIII]]. It was the site of numerous [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] under [[Xim's empire|Xim's Empire]],<ref name="Xim Week" /> which were used construct [[Starship/Legends|starships]].<ref name="EGtW:AC">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-3-xim-the-despot|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 3 - "Xim the Despot"}}</ref> By the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], however, millennia of war and decay had left most of the yards derelict, but fitful industry still struggled along. Many of the ancient docks had become the lairs of smugglers and outlaws.<ref name="Xim Week" /> Many [[Standard year/Legends|millennia]] after Xim's reign, the [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Bleys Harand]] described the remains of the [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] in his work of literature ''[[Travels Amid Strange Stars]]'', which described his search for a contemporary depiction of Xim. All that remained of the shipyards by this time however, were coils of [[Steel/Legends|steel]] which had been darkened in [[Color/Legends|color]] due to irradiation, and were covered in markings from [[Meteorite/Legends|micrometeorite]] strikes.<ref name="EGtW:AC" />
